exercises.purpose: Direct low-axial lateral-glute and hip-abduction work that fills the frontal-plane glute role without adding another squat or hinge.
coachingCues: Set the pelvis and torso before starting the set.
Drive the knees outward under control instead of bouncing into range.
Pause briefly in the shortened position and return without letting the stack slam.
Keep the set in the lateral glutes rather than turning it into a whole-body effort.
commonMistakes: Rocking the torso to move more weight.
Using momentum or letting the weight stack crash.
Chasing extreme range that changes pelvic position.
Loading the movement so heavily that the low-axial support role becomes a maximal-effort set.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Jeff Nippard glute-specialization role evidence + LetMeFly RT-020 lateral-hip role governance + Black Crown v2.1 intentional program amendment

exercises.purpose: Low-setup, low-axial direct hip-abduction work used when the abductor machine is unavailable while preserving the same lateral-glute support role.
coachingCues: Sit tall with both feet planted and the pelvis steady.
Press the knees apart smoothly and keep tension through the full set.
Pause briefly before returning under control.
Choose a band that allows consistent knee tracking without torso rocking.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the knees in and out.
Rocking the torso to create more range.
Letting the knees snap inward between reps.
Using a band too heavy to control.
exercises.evidenceBasis: Jeff Nippard glute-specialization role evidence + LetMeFly RT-020 lateral-hip role governance

substitutionRules.importantDifference: Machine loading is more stable and externally quantifiable; band resistance is less precise but preserves direct abduction intent.
substitutionRules.loadingAdjustment: Use the program's fallback rep/effort guidance; never copy machine-stack load to band work.
substitutionRules.evidenceBasis: Black Crown v2.1 lateral-glute amendment + RT-020
substitutionRules.coachExplanation: Same direct lateral-glute role with a different resistance profile.
substitutionRules.programOwnershipRule: Black Crown owns the slot and dose; substitution does not add volume.

substitutionRules.importantDifference: Lateral walking adds standing balance, locomotion, knee/foot control, and a less isolated resistance profile.
